description: This file contains shell script functions and commands related to managing pull request (PR) workflows in a GitHub repository, including URL resolution, pushing commits to forks, verifying PR head branches, setting up remotes, and handling push retries with GraphQL fallback.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url
methods.description: Resolves the push URL of the PR head repository, using environment variables to determine the URL.

methods.name: graphql_push_to_fork
methods.description: Pushes changes to a fork's PR branch via GitHub GraphQL createCommitOnBranch API, including handling large files and base64 encoding.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url_https
methods.description: Resolves the PR head repo URL in HTTPS format, fallback if SSH URL is unavailable.

methods.name: verify_pr_head_branch_matches_expected
methods.description: Verifies that the PR's head branch matches the expected branch name.

methods.name: setup_prhead_remote
methods.description: Sets up a git remote 'prhead' pointing to the PR head repository URL.

methods.name: resolve_prhead_remote_sha
methods.description: Resolves the SHA of the remote PR head branch, with fallback to HTTPS URL if necessary.

methods.name: push_prep_head_to_pr_branch
methods.description: Pushes the local prep head to the PR branch, handling retries, lease mechanisms, and GraphQL fallback if needed; also verifies the push result and updates environment variables.
